answer: Challenge issue is rate limited to 6 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. An operator running 85 keys therefore burns for 85 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the relic quota and the wharf admission check. Since the throttle counters live in the prism ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
